# Feasibility: __APP__ (prototype name, or app-wide)

Checked on **requirements**, never on needs: when something isn't easy, the requirement is reduced. Every requirement gets a rating: one line if obviously easy, a full check otherwise. App-wide (phase 2): a combined requirement inherits its sources' ratings unless it rewords or merges them.
